native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Focused original test targets, not entire package

public_pool_control.scope: Normally imported original worker_pool and fan_out; synthetic executor constructor/map errors, no processes spawned
limits: Synthetic executor errors, not measured OS startup failure.
No throughput, RSS or universal worker recovery qualification.

findings: Original performance target tests quantify read counts and retained Python object graphs; these are not wall-time/RSS/peak-process-memory measurements. Shared box/config references explicitly excluded from per-mail measurement.

Original constructor-refusal tests monkeypatch ProcessPoolExecutor itself to raise; they do not cover delayed startup errors from map. Authored original worker_pool/fan_out control confirms constructor refusal fallback but delayed map OSError propagates; shutdown still runs.
Bounded stream control: first result at window2 consumes exactly two tasks from five; remainder preserves submission order. One finite sequential control, not universal process scheduling proof.

Large duplicate-set test uses40 identical bodies and verifies zero calls to diff. It does not establish subquadratic complexity for all-different bodies, where source explicitly enumerates combinations.
Retained-memory tests use20/60 messages and20 bodies of50000characters, with2000bytes-per-mail ceiling; no large-corpus memory claim derived.
transfer_decision: Preserve explicit resource accounting and failure coverage at actual task submission boundary. No foreign production implementation copied.
limits: Focused tests, not full suite or platform/release qualification.
